name: Nex

mechanics.name: Standard Attacks
mechanics.description: Nex claws whoever is closest, following up with two more strikes if they stay in range, and casts a magic attack out to ten tiles that takes on the element of whichever phase she is in.
mechanics.counterplay: Keep everyone but the designated tank out of melee range, and pray against whichever style she is using.

mechanics.name: Smoke Dash
mechanics.description: She shouts that there is no escape and darts down one of the four aisles, hitting everything in that lane.
mechanics.counterplay: Watch which way she turns and get out of that aisle before she moves.

mechanics.name: Blood Siphon
mechanics.description: She summons a pack of blood reavers and kneels. While she is kneeling every point of damage dealt to her heals her instead.
mechanics.counterplay: Stop attacking her and clear the reavers. Every hit you land on her while she kneels is healing she keeps.

mechanics.name: Containment
mechanics.description: She smashes the floor and icicles erupt across the tiles immediately around her. The hit lands through protection prayers.
mechanics.counterplay: Stay off the tiles next to her while the ice phase is running.

mechanics.name: Zarosian Prayers
mechanics.description: In her last phase she starts praying. Turmoil makes her attacks land far harder and drains your combat stats, Soul Split heals her for the damage she deals, and Deflect Melee sends your own melee damage back at you.
mechanics.counterplay: Switch off melee the moment she deflects it, and expect to take damage through prayer.

mechanics.name: Attuned Followers
mechanics.description: Fumus, Umbra, Cruor and Glacies stand at the corners of the room. Each is invulnerable until Nex drops to that follower's health threshold, and she cannot be hurt further until the unlocked one is dead.
mechanics.counterplay: Send someone to the corner as soon as a follower becomes attackable. The fight does not move on until it dies.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc ids: NEX 11278, NEX_SPAWNING 11279, NEX_SOULSPLIT 11280, NEX_DEFLECT 11281 and NEX_DYING 11282 are all in npcIds, because Nex swaps npc id as her Zarosian prayers change rather than spawning a new npc, and an npc transform has to be tracked as the boss for her animations to keep matching (docs/DECISIONS.md D17). The four attuned followers (Fumus 11283, Umbra 11284, Cruor 11285, Glacies 11286) and the blood reavers (11293, 11294) are deliberately NOT in npcIds: they are adds, so they detect on npc-spawn, the same call already shipped for Zulrah's snakelings. Animations, all unambiguous gameval names: NEX_ATTACK 9180, NEX_CAST_ATTACK 9189, NEX_DASH_ATTACK 9178, NEX_BLOOD_SIPHON 9183, NEX_SMASH_ATTACK 9186 and NEX_TURMOIL 9179. NEX_SMASH_ATTACK 9186 IS CURATED AS CONTAINMENT ON AN INFERENCE: the wiki describes containment as smashing the floor to raise icicles around her, which is the only floor smash in her move list, but the gameval name says only 'smash' and the shadow phase also has a floor-targeted mechanic, so the live pass should confirm 9186 is not in fact the shadow smash. NEX_BLAST_AWAY 9182, NEX_SPIN_OUT 9187, NEX_ALTERNATE_CAST_ATTACK 9188 and NEX_SUMMON 9202 are named but unassigned; they are the candidates for the mechanics missing below. DETECTION IS ANIMATION AND NPC-SPAWN ONLY, BY DELIBERATE CHOICE FOR EVERY SKELETON IN THIS WAVE. Projectile triggers fall back to a boss-presence gate when the game reports no source actor, and graphic triggers have no source actor at all (docs/DECISIONS.md D17), so an unverified id of either kind can false-positive, and discovery never revokes (D18). NEX_BLOOD_SIPHON_SPOTANIM 9190, NEX_TURMOIL_SPOTANIM 9191, NEX_SPOT_SOULSPLIT_PROJ 9197, NEX_SPOT_LEECH_PROJ 9198, _IMPACT 9199 and NEX_MUSHROOM_CLOUD_PROJANIM 9200 / _SPOTANIM 9201 are the ids to add during the live pass. Several signature mechanics are consequently absent: choke, drag, shadow smash, embrace darkness, blood sacrifice, ice prison and the death wrath all key off spotanims or player-side effects rather than a distinct body animation, and none of them is curated rather than being hung on a wrong trigger. THE FOLLOWERS PREVIEW USES UMBRA 11284 SPECIFICALLY. Fumus, Cruor and Glacies each carry a six-pair recolour table over the same shared base models, and under SCHEMA.md's recolor-table rule a widget cannot apply an npc's recolour table, so all three would render in the wrong colour. Umbra alone has no recolour table, so it is the one follower that previews colour-true. It plays the generic HUMAN_READY 808 standing animation, per docs/DECISIONS.md D26's prefer-the-idle guidance. Its zoom is raised above FitZoom's own fit for the same reason four models in this wave are: its vertical envelope sits entirely above the ground line the engine anchors to, so the shiftY that centres it projects past the 70px half-box ceiling BundledBossDataTest enforces, and raising zoom shrinks the model and its offset by the same factor. Nex's own five previews all fit inside the ceiling and ship at FitZoom's values. staticFallback is false on all six; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Nex', matching 'name'.

It needs a bundled 287x136 sprite: the npc is a multi-part equipment assembly whose models[0] is its head, it has no Combat Achievements page and therefore no pre-merged model, and a whole-cache search for a model matching its summed vertex and face counts finds nothing.
